notes: Both C rows require POS_DEAD and LVL_IMPL-1; the focused registration test pins the distinct abbreviation and full-command gates under R1/R2/R5e.
The abbreviation uses subcmd 0 and emits the exact refusal with CRLF, regardless of trailing arguments under R1/R2/R3/R5e.
The do_shutdown subcmd guard returns before one_argument, so trailing reboot text cannot reach a shutdown arm under R1/R2/R3/R5e.
An unrecognized full-command option emits only Unknown shutdown option. and leaves global shutdown state unchanged under R1/R3/R5e.
C str_cmp is case-insensitive, so an unrecognized mixed-case option follows the same refusal under R1/R3/R5e.
The empty full command broadcasts exactly Shutting down. to every authenticated player and requests clean shutdown without an invented actor-only line under R1/R3/R5e.
The reboot arm broadcasts exactly Rebooting.. come back in a minute or two. and requests reboot under R1/R3/R5e.
Die and pause share exactly Shutting down for maintenance. and request their distinct marker modes under R1/R3/R5e.
Valid arms set shutdown and invoke the C-equivalent all-save/house-save continuation contract; unknown options do not request shutdown under R3/R5e.
